caseNameFull: Finley, Clerk of the Circuit Court of Cook County, Illinois v. Murray

opinions.text: C. A. 7th Cir. [Cer-tiorari granted, ante, p. 962.] Motion for appointment of counsel granted, and it is ordered that John S. Elson, Esquire, of Chicago, Ill., be appointed to serve as counsel for respondent in this case.
